Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer at EUR 5.50. We cannot approve it.

You asked for the basis of our target. It comes from the package itself. The AS-14404 clause already moves the 45% material share with the market in both directions, so the base price no longer needs to carry alloy risk. Payment in 14 days improves your cash flow. The 36-month commitment secures 23,700 kg per year for three years. Your owner previously offered to walk us through your calculation (doc:20260904-70740-M1). We would welcome a written breakdown of the non-material elements you see in the base price.

In response to your move, we revise our proposal to one complete package:
- Unit price: EUR 4.51
- Payment: 14 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, material share 45%, deadband 0%, base month 2026-08

All other terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling. Earlier payment, the three-year commitment at this annual quantity and the indexed material share are offered only together and only at this package price.

Please reply with one complete binding offer. Which non-material cost element prevents approval, and what base price can your pricing committee approve for these exact conditions?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

calculation_requests.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your Angebot and for setting out the cost drivers so clearly.

We have checked your index arguments:

- **Material and labour:** We agree that AS-14404 (+5.9%) and labour costs (LCI-C, +2.7%) are relevant. On your stated cost shares (45% and 5%), they justify roughly +2.8%.
- **PPI-C2431:** This is an output price index for drawn bar. It already contains the alloy surcharge movement, so adding it on top counts the material increase twice.
- **Current price:** Starting from today's €5.84, a fair adjustment would land well below €6.10.
- **Your earlier quote:** Your own quote of 9 September was €6.06.
- **Market:** We also hold a competitive DAP quote for this part at €5.45 (material covered until March 2027).

Your owner has kindly offered to walk us through your calculation (material and hourly rates). We would welcome that if it helps settle the price.

We would like to give you something you have said matters to you: volume security. Instead of 12 months, we propose a 24-month contract, which secures your full volume of 23,700 kg per year for two years.

We can offer the following packages. All are DAP, with a 14-day lead time, effective 1 January 2027:

| Package | Price | Zahlungsziel | Term | Index clause |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | €5.55/kg | 60 days | 24 months | none |
| B | €5.51/kg | 30 days | 24 months | none |
| C | €5.36/kg | 60 days | 24 months | AS-14404, 45% material share, 3% deadband, base month 2026-08 |

- **Package B** gives you faster cash flow than our current 60 days.
- **Package C** reflects your proposal for a Preisgleitklausel. With an index clause, the risk is shared in both directions, so the base price has to be correspondingly lower.

Could you let us know which package works best for you, or which structure you would prefer to build on? We are keen to settle this in good time before your pricing committee's next meeting.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation for part:370010 (1.4404 round bar, dia 30 mm, peeled).

We would like to continue with Blankstahl Werdenfels and are prepared to offer a meaningful commitment: the full 23,700 per year, fixed for 24 months from 1 January 2027. That gives you exactly the kind of stable, volume-based account your sales director has described as your focus.

However, we cannot accept €6.10. That is an increase of 4.5% on today's €5.84. Your own figures do not support it:
- AS-14404 at a 45% cost share and +5.9% accounts for roughly 2.7%.
- The PPI-C2431 movement largely reflects the same alloy and material inflation. Applying both on top of each other double-counts the material effect.
- Your delivery performance (OTD around 81% over the last four quarters) is also something we have to weigh against any increase.
- In each of the last three renewals we settled below the level initially asked.

We would also gladly take up your owner's offer to walk us through the calculation (material and hourly rates). If there is a cost element we are missing, we are happy to look at it on facts.

On that basis we propose the following packages. All three are equivalent for us, so please choose the one that suits you best:
1. €5.18 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
2. €5.14 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
3. €5.09 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause

All other terms as per your quotation (DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 per year, valid from 2027-01-01).

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
